insider_note: The circle here is the simple x² + y² = 4, with no linear terms at all — do not let that simplicity skip the family-of-circles setup; the marks are for the METHOD, not just the final line.

(At a point on both, S = 0 and L = 0, so

lines.text: S + λL = 0 there, for every number λ.)

steps.why: S + λL = 0 is the family of every circle through the same two intersection points as the given circle and line — one member of it will have AB as a diameter.
common_mistakes: Writing L as 2x + 3y = 1 without moving the 1 across, then adding a wrong constant.
Forgetting the constant −4 in S while combining terms.
steps.memory_tip: Clear every line to (expression) = 0 first — a family formula only works cleanly once both S and L equal zero.
